card.name: Closing bracket before a colon or list
card.fires_on: The closing bracket of a [see ... (section number)] cross-reference, or the last word of a lead-in sentence, where a colon and a bulleted list or formula is about to follow.

modes.label: Cross-reference bracket
modes.description: Closing ] or )] after a section number in a [see Warnings and Precautions (5.x)] reference.

modes.label: Lead-in before a list
modes.description: Last word of a sentence that introduces a list or formula and is followed by a colon or period.
modes.example: avanafil is not recommended for the following<< groups>>: • Patients who have suffered a myocard

card.writes: It promotes punctuation such as colons and closing quote-colon marks, and suppresses closing brackets and parentheses.
card.plain: It marks the end of a label cross-reference or lead-in phrase where a colon and a list usually come next.
